definitions: A river in north-east Scotland, flowing east through Aberdeenshire to the North Sea at Aberdeen.
A river in Russia, flowing south-east and then south-west to the Black Sea.
A title given to a university lecturer or fellow at Oxford or Cambridge.
A Spanish title, prefixed to a man's given name to show respect.
examples: The River Don is known for its salmon fishing.
The Don flows into the Sea of Azov.
He was a distinguished Don at the university.
Don Quixote is a famous literary character.
